info.title: Analytics API
info.description: Sales, pricing, performance, and marketplace data, all in one place with low latency.

post.summary: Collection Floor Price and Listings Candlesticks
post.description: Returns historical floor price or more extensive open / high / floor / close candlesticks for collection listings at marketplaces at a selected time interval, as well as the number of active listings, the number of unique owners and the average age of open listings

collection_address.description: The Ethereum contract address to identify the collection.

floor_only.description: If `true`, report only historical floor prices. Otherwise, report OHFC candlesticks, number of active listings, number of unique owners and the average age of open listings.

frequency.description: The interval at which to return Floor prices / OHLF, e.g. `1D` for daily, `1M` for monthly etc. Must be >= `6H`

rept_curr.description: The currency to report results in

report_start_date.description: The ISO 8601 start date/datetime to return results for

report_end_date.description: The ISO 8601 end date/datetime to return results for

trait_type.description: Specify if results to be reported only for certain values of this trait type

trait_value.description: The trait value(s) of type `trait_type` to report results for

200.description: An object containing the collection sales OHLC prices
